about: Recurring symbols (the owner's rule 5). Source of truth; tools/content/symbols.py audits it and writes content/symbols.md. Scores 0-2: link (sound-alike or literal tie to the term), concrete, unmistakable, drawable (an image generator gets it right), sticky (remembered at first sight). A symbol is approved when every score is at least 1, the total is at least 8, and its anchor words are its own. Terms starting with '=' match only a keyword term that is exactly that word.

symbols.symbol: the HART Hotel: a narrow old hotel seen cut open like a doll's house, a stag's head (a hart) over its door; blue wing on the viewer's left = right heart, red wing on the right = left heart; glass-roofed atrium lobbies upstairs, engine rooms with ventilation fans downstairs; the party wall = the septum
symbols.why: hart = heart; one fixed map for every intracardiac lesson
symbols.notes: The stag's head is small; the building carries the meaning. Keep the colours (blue = right, red = left) in every picture: generators get colours right more often than left and right.

symbols.symbol: a glass-roofed atrium lobby on the upper floor of the HART Hotel
symbols.why: the word itself

symbols.symbol: a ground-floor engine room of the HART Hotel with a huge ventilation fan and thick brick walls
symbols.why: VENT-ricle

symbols.symbol: the chimney of the HART Hotel's blue wing
symbols.why: blood comes down into the right atrium from above

symbols.symbol: a white marble Venus statue in a hole at the very top of the upper party wall, under the chimney
symbols.why: VEN-osus = Venus

symbols.symbol: a round clock with a sweeping second hand in the middle of the upper party wall
symbols.why: SECUND-um = second

symbols.symbol: a prime rib roast in a hole at the very bottom of the upper party wall, beside the valve doors
symbols.why: PRIM-um = prime
symbols.notes: Say 'prime rib roast on a platter' so it is not just any meat.

symbols.symbol: a sink with a little green crown, set in the floor of the blue lobby
symbols.why: corona + sinus = crown + sink

symbols.symbol: a giant orca parade balloon; its arched back is the aortic arch
symbols.why: a-OR-ta / OR-ca

symbols.symbol: a rope pinching the orca's waist just past its left flipper
symbols.why: a narrowing you can see

symbols.symbol: the orca balloon's flipper
symbols.why: the subclavian feeds the arm; the flipper is the orca's arm
symbols.notes: Left and right flippers are easy to confuse: say which one in 'must'.

symbols.symbol: pipes, ropes or slings of green dollar bills
symbols.why: PUL-MON-ary = pull money

symbols.symbol: a big round pressure gauge with its needle swung into the red zone
symbols.why: pressure, read off a gauge; red = too high

symbols.symbol: a pipe of dollar bills whose pressure gauge jumps into the red; the pipe swells and bursts
symbols.why: pull money + a gauge in the red
symbols.notes: Replaces the rejected Wall Street crash.

symbols.symbol: a Wall Street crash on a red ticker board
symbols.why: money + panic
symbols.notes: Rejected by the audit: a crash is an event, not a thing, and ticker boards come out as gibberish text.

symbols.symbol: a tunnel of shiny silver duct tape between the orca and the money pipe
symbols.why: DUCT-us = duct tape

symbols.symbol: the green crown of the Statue of Liberty, seven spikes
symbols.why: corona = crown; CORON-ary

symbols.symbol: the Liberty crown with its spikes clogged by black tar
symbols.why: the crown that feeds the heart is blocked
symbols.notes: Shares the crown with 'coronary' on purpose: same family.

symbols.symbol: a bishop's mitre, two leaves meeting at a point
symbols.why: MITR-al = mitre; the classic image

symbols.symbol: a trident, three prongs
symbols.why: TRI-cuspid = three points

symbols.concept: Conduction system, bundle of His, bundle branches
symbols.symbol: a bundle of branches crackling with electric sparks
symbols.why: the bundle and its branches, literally
symbols.notes: The sparks tell it from firewood.

symbols.symbol: a New York police officer pushing down with straight, locked arms
symbols.why: C-P-R = COP-eR, and the compression itself

symbols.symbol: a car being jump-started with sparking jumper cables
symbols.why: CAR-dioversion; an electric shock

symbols.symbol: a marching drummer keeping a steady beat
symbols.why: the one who makes the pace
symbols.notes: Never put a drummer in a picture for decoration.

symbols.symbol: a nun, 'a sister', lying perfectly still on a flat white line
symbols.why: a-SIS-tole = a sister; the flat line

symbols.symbol: a lit red firework rocket
symbols.why: the adrenaline rush
symbols.notes: The weakest approved symbol (no sound-alike); replace it if a better one is found.

symbols.symbol: a shining gold trophy cup
symbols.why: a-TRO-pine = TRO-phy

symbols.symbol: a big can of white chalky glue
symbols.why: GLU-conate = glue; calcium = chalk

symbols.symbol: a bat sending out rings of sound and seeing by their echoes
symbols.why: ECHO-cardiography; a bat sees by echoes, as ultrasound does
symbols.notes: Replaces the rejected 'echo in the Whispering Gallery'.

symbols.symbol: an echo travelling along the Whispering Gallery as a thread of light
symbols.why: echo
symbols.notes: Rejected by the audit: an echo is not a thing; a thread of light can mean anything.

symbols.symbol: flashing red and blue police-car lights
symbols.why: the two colours of colour Doppler; a passing siren is the Doppler effect
symbols.notes: In a Doppler picture say 'red and blue police-car lights'; a police officer alone means CPR.

symbols.symbol: a lightning bolt striking the head
symbols.why: a stroke of lightning

symbols.symbol: a traffic jam: yellow taxis gridlocked bumper to bumper
symbols.why: congestion

symbols.symbol: playing cards sprouting broccoli and moss
symbols.why: endo-CARD-itis; vegetations

layers.meaning: vegetations = broccoli and moss sprouting from them
layers.place: set on the valve that is infected

symbols.symbol: a soft bouncy castle (compliant) against a stiff steel vault
symbols.why: soft fills easily

symbols.symbol: the stern of a ship opened straight down a white centre line
symbols.why: STERN-otomy; the median line

symbols.symbol: a coffin
symbols.why: death itself

symbols.symbol: a hart (a stag) brought down by an arrow
symbols.why: heart attack = HART attack
symbols.notes: Replaces the rejected 'split red weight' of Shahzad 2015 for every new book (pictures already published stay).

symbols.symbol: a split red weight
symbols.notes: Rejected by the audit: nothing in it says 'infarction'.

symbols.symbol: the orca balloon's mouth, where the orca leaves the red engine room; a sagging mouth that drips water back is a leaking valve
symbols.why: the door by which blood enters the aorta (the orca)

symbols.symbol: a giant falling Tetris piece of four glowing blocks, one feature in each block
symbols.why: TETRA-logy = Tetris, four blocks; of FALL-ot = falling

symbols.symbol: the orca balloon sitting astride the party wall, half over each engine room
symbols.why: it rides over both ventricles

symbols.concept: Pulmonary stenosis, right ventricular outflow obstruction
symbols.symbol: a pipe of dollar bills squeezed narrow by an iron clamp
symbols.why: pull money + a narrowing you can tighten

symbols.symbol: the blue engine room with its walls swollen into thick red muscle
symbols.why: a thick-walled right ventricle

symbols.symbol: a raised beer stein, "Prost!", propping the duct-tape tunnel open
symbols.why: PROST-aglandin = Prost!, the toast

symbols.symbol: a leather belt buckled tight around the pipe of dollar bills
symbols.why: a band around the pulmonary artery

terms: systemic artery to pulmonary artery shunt
symbols.symbol: a hose joining the orca's flipper to the pipe of dollar bills
symbols.why: subclavian (flipper) to pulmonary (dollars)

symbols.concept: Atresia (a valve or vessel closed from birth)
symbols.symbol: a pipe welded shut with a thick iron cap
symbols.why: no opening at all

symbols.symbol: a vendor tossing Bing cherries through the hole under the dollar pipe
symbols.why: TAUSSIG-Bing = tossing Bing cherries

symbols.symbol: the orca and the dollar pipe swapped: the orca leaving the blue engine room, the dollar pipe the red one
symbols.why: the great arteries trade places
symbols.notes: Say it in 'must': generators blur which pipe leaves which room.

symbols.symbol: both the orca and the dollar pipe rising out of the blue engine room
symbols.why: two outlets from the right ventricle

symbols.symbol: an iceman pushing blue blocks of ice back through the hole, from the blue side to the red
symbols.why: EISEN-menger = ice-man; blue (venous) pushed into the red side

symbols.concept: Fontan operation (venous blood to the lungs with no pumping ventricle)
symbols.symbol: a stone fountain in the hotel courtyard, fed by the blue wing's chimney, its water running straight into the pipes of dollar bills by gravity, with no pump
symbols.why: FONTAN = fountain (Italian fontana); a fountain flows with no pump, as Fontan blood reaches the lungs with no ventricle

symbols.symbol: an astronaut in a white spacesuit (John Glenn) bending the blue wing's chimney down and plugging it straight into the pipe of dollar bills
symbols.why: GLENN = John Glenn, the astronaut New York welcomed with a ticker-tape parade; he joins the chimney (SVC) to the money pipe (pulmonary artery)

symbols.symbol: a little plastic toy hippo wedged into a red wing shrunk to doll size
symbols.why: HYPO-PLASTIC = hippo + plastic; the red (left) wing is shrunk to a toy

symbols.symbol: one thick tree trunk rising from both engine rooms, astride the hole in the party wall, with the orca and the pipes of dollar bills branching off it
symbols.why: TRUNCUS = trunk: one trunk, all branches off it
symbols.notes: anchor is 'tree trunk', not 'trunk', to leave 'elephant trunk' (the arch operation) free

symbols.symbol: a subway switchman pulling a big railway switch lever that swings the orca and the pipe of dollar bills back to their own engine rooms, the Liberty crowns riding along with the orca
symbols.why: SWITCH: the great arteries are switched back; the coronaries go with the new aorta

symbols.symbol: a giant squeeze bottle of yellow mustard drawing a thick mustard wall across the upper lobbies that crosses the two streams over
symbols.why: MUSTARD (the surgeon's name) = mustard; the baffle in the atria redirects the streams. Senning is the same idea

symbols.symbol: a round red party balloon on a string, yanked through the upper party wall so that it tears the hole wider
symbols.why: the procedure is literally a balloon pulled through the atrial septum

symbols.symbol: a huge ox wearing a clear oxygen mask
symbols.why: OX-ygen = ox

symbols.symbol: a man breathing fast into a brown paper bag
symbols.why: the paper bag is the picture everyone knows for hyperventilation

symbols.symbol: wooden blocks stacked inside the pipe of dollar bills, one block for each Wood unit
symbols.why: WOOD units = wooden blocks that resist the flow of money

symbols.symbol: a pirate shouting ARRR and dancing a wild jig out of step with the music
symbols.why: ARRR-rhythm-ia = a pirate's ARRR + a broken rhythm

terms: right ventricle to pulmonary artery conduit
symbols.symbol: a clear twisting waterslide tube from the blue engine room to the pipe of dollar bills
symbols.why: a conduit is a tube built to carry flow; a waterslide tube is the one nobody forgets

symbols.symbol: a child with bright blue (cyan) lips and fingertips
symbols.why: CYAN-osis = cyan blue

symbols.concept: Ross operation (pulmonary autograft to the aortic position)
symbols.symbol: a gardener moving a red rose from the mouth of the pipe of dollar bills to the orca balloon's mouth
symbols.why: ROSS = rose; the patient's own pulmonary valve is moved to the aortic position

symbols.symbol: a pink pig
symbols.why: porcine = pig

symbols.concept: commissurotomy, valvotomy (cutting fused valve leaflets apart)
symbols.symbol: a tailor's big scissors snipping apart lips that have been sewn together
symbols.why: the fused commissures are cut apart like a seam

symbols.concept: subaortic (subvalvular aortic) stenosis, the subaortic membrane
symbols.symbol: a shower curtain stretched across the red engine room's doorway just below the orca's mouth
symbols.why: a membrane hung just below the aortic valve

symbols.symbol: a sculptor chiselling a block out of the bulging lower party wall
symbols.why: muscle is carved out of the septum

symbols.symbol: the lower party wall swollen into the huge bulging biceps of a bodybuilder, crowding the red room's doorway to the orca
symbols.why: a muscle-bound septum that blocks the outflow

symbols.symbol: an ice-hockey goalkeeper slamming his big blocker pad against the puck
symbols.why: a goalie's 'blocker' pad: the blocker that stops the beat-raising shots

symbols.symbol: a canal (a channel) dammed by a spilled can of white chalky glue
symbols.why: calcium = chalky glue (as for calcium), channel = canal, blocked

symbols.symbol: a tight pearl necklace choking the orca balloon just above its mouth
symbols.why: a narrowing just ABOVE the valve, like a necklace above the mouth

symbols.symbol: a young lad sliding down the front of the Statue of Liberty's green crown
symbols.why: LAD = a lad, sliding down the FRONT (anterior, descending)

symbols.symbol: big green cabbage leaves laid as bridges over the tar-clogged spikes of the Liberty crown
symbols.why: CABG is said 'cabbage'; the leaves bridge the blocked parts

symbols.symbol: a heavy stone angel sitting on a man's chest
symbols.why: ANGINA ~ angel; the weight on the chest

symbols.symbol: a nightclub bouncer ejecting guests out of the red engine room's door, a counter showing the share thrown out
symbols.why: EJECTION = thrown out; the FRACTION thrown out with each beat

symbols.symbol: a man sitting on a mountain of white sugar cubes
symbols.why: sugar in the blood

symbols.symbol: a coiled metal Slinky spring pushed on a long wire into a clogged pipe to hold it open
symbols.why: a stent is a metal coil that springs a narrowed artery open

symbols.symbol: the opened stern of a ship rotting with green mould along its white centre line
symbols.why: the sternotomy (the ship's stern) gone rotten

symbols.symbol: a green lima bean vine growing down from the chest wall onto the front of the Liberty crown
symbols.why: LIMA = lima bean; a living vine, not a cut-off piece

symbols.symbol: a chain of blue sapphires laid as a bridge over a clogged spike of the Liberty crown
symbols.why: SAPHenous = sapphire, blue like a vein

symbols.concept: gated equilibrium radionuclide study (MUGA, gated blood pool)
symbols.symbol: a big glowing green coffee mug filled slowly, drip by drip, over many beats
symbols.why: MUGA = mug; it is built up over hundreds of beats

symbols.symbol: one glowing green shot glass downed in a single gulp
symbols.why: the bolus is seen on its first, single pass

symbols.symbol: a bucket of ice-cold water full of bananas poured over the hotel so that its fans stop dead
symbols.why: the solution is cold and rich in potassium (bananas); it stops the heart still

symbols.symbol: a big pink bubble-gum bubble bulging out of a wall
symbols.why: a thin-walled bulge that can burst

symbols.symbol: a street-corner elevator platform stuck in its raised position
symbols.why: ST = STreet, elevation = ELEVATOR stuck up

symbols.symbol: a bright green Kawasaki motorcycle ridden by a feverish child
symbols.why: KAWASAKI = the motorcycle brand

symbols.symbol: a glass snow globe glowing with green gamma rays
symbols.why: GLOBulin = globe; gamma = the glowing rays

symbols.concept: Ebstein's anomaly (tricuspid valve displaced down into the right ventricle)
symbols.symbol: Einstein, wild white hair, pushing the trident down into the blue engine room
symbols.why: EBSTEIN ~ Einstein; the tricuspid valve is pushed down into the ventricle

symbols.symbol: a fist punching a hole straight through from one pipe into its neighbour
symbols.why: FIST-ula = a fist punched through

symbols.symbol: a cement mixer roaring nonstop
symbols.why: a machine that never stops, through systole and diastole

symbols.concept: anomalous origin of the left coronary artery from the pulmonary artery (ALCAPA)
terms: origin of the left coronary artery from the pulmonary artery
anomalous origin of the left coronary artery
anomalous left coronary artery from the pulmonary artery
symbols.symbol: Al Capone in a pinstripe suit bolting the left spike of the Liberty crown onto the pipe of dollar bills
symbols.why: ALCAPA ~ Al Capone, who puts the crown on the money

symbols.symbol: a man fainting backwards onto a red velvet couch
symbols.why: the faint itself

terms: aortic valve replacement for aortic stenosis
symbols.symbol: a dentist fitting brand-new dentures into the orca balloon's mouth
symbols.why: a new 'mouth' for the orca

symbols.symbol: a black bowling ball rolling out through the pipes and knocking things over
symbols.why: em-BOWL-us = a bowling ball that travels and blocks

symbols.symbol: Pinocchio, his long nose growing, trembling all over in the upper glass lobby
symbols.why: FIB-rillation = fibbing, Pinocchio; he quivers, he never beats

symbols.symbol: harp strings tying the bishop's mitre down to the floor of the red engine room
symbols.why: CHORDae = the chords (strings) of a harp

symbols.symbol: soggy dollar bills dripping with water, spilling from the money pipes
symbols.why: the lungs (money) waterlogged

symbols.symbol: a soft paper tissue box set in as the valve
symbols.why: TISSUE valve = a box of tissues: soft, wears out, needs no rat poison

symbols.symbol: a clanking little steel robot set in as the valve
symbols.why: a machine: lasts for ever, needs warfarin for ever

symbols.symbol: a rat in a soldier's helmet
symbols.why: WAR-farin = war; it began as a rat poison

symbols.symbol: a black umbrella snapping open
symbols.why: the stiff valve snaps open just after the second sound

symbols.symbol: a grey wolf digging a shortcut tunnel straight from an upper lobby down to an engine room, past the sparking bundle of branches
symbols.why: WOLFF = a wolf; the accessory pathway is his shortcut

symbols.concept: re-entry circuit (AV node re-entry and other re-entrant tachycardias)
symbols.symbol: a toy train (a little subway train) circling forever round a loop of two tracks, express and local
symbols.why: the impulse goes round and round a loop of two pathways

symbols.symbol: a green hedge maze grown across both upper lobbies, leading the beat from the top to the knot
symbols.why: the operation is named after the maze it makes

symbols.symbol: a blowtorch burning a spot black
symbols.why: tissue is burnt to stop it conducting

symbols.symbol: a wobbling ball of green jelly on a stalk, hanging from the clock on the party wall into the lobby
symbols.why: MYXO = mucus, slime: a jelly on a stalk from the fossa ovalis (the clock)

symbols.symbol: a red crab
symbols.why: cancer = the crab (Hippocrates' karkinos)
symbols.notes: Lung cancer = the crab clamping a sack of dollar bills (the lung). Metastases are its baby crabs (own symbol, same family).

symbols.symbol: a raised drawbridge between the upper lobby and the engine room, so no signal can cross
symbols.why: the signal cannot cross from atria to ventricles

symbols.symbol: an orchestra conductor at the top of the blue lobby beside the chimney, beating time with his baton
symbols.why: the sinus node sets the time for the whole heart

symbols.symbol: a tennis player serving an ace at the US Open in Queens
symbols.why: ACE inhibitor = a tennis ace

symbols.symbol: a coal miner with a lamp on his helmet, pushing hard
symbols.why: dopa-MINE = a miner

symbols.symbol: a tall windmill turning its sails
symbols.why: MIL-rinone = a mill; amrinone its older twin

symbols.symbol: a strong Doberman dog pulling on its leash
symbols.why: DOBUtamine = a Doberman

symbols.symbol: a tall purple foxglove flower
symbols.why: digitalis comes from the foxglove (Digitalis purpurea)

symbols.symbol: a Prussian soldier in a spiked helmet throwing the city's gates wide open
symbols.why: nitro-PRUSSIDE = a Prussian; it opens the arteries (afterload)

symbols.symbol: a cowboy's lasso pulling water out of a flooded room
symbols.why: LASIX = lasso; it pulls the water out

symbols.symbol: a fast brown hare
symbols.why: HEpARin ~ hare: quick on, quick off

symbols.symbol: a small asp snake coiled round a white tablet
symbols.why: ASPirin = an asp

symbols.symbol: a brass ear trumpet held up to listen
symbols.why: the pacemaker listens before it beats

symbols.symbol: a big roller-pump truck parked beside the hotel, its hoses plugged into the chimney and the orca
symbols.why: the roller pump of the heart-lung machine takes over the circulation

symbols.symbol: a long sausage-shaped balloon inside the orca's belly, swelling when the fans rest and shrinking just before they push
symbols.why: a long balloon in the aorta that inflates in diastole and deflates before systole

symbols.symbol: a tin man with a clockwork heart
symbols.why: the man of tin who was given a heart

symbols.symbol: one single big engine room with no party wall, both lobby doors opening into it
symbols.why: one ventricle receiving both inlets

symbols.symbol: a bicycle wedged in the orca's mouth, its two wheels for the two lips
symbols.why: BI-cuspid = BI-cycle, two

symbols.symbol: baby crabs that have scuttled away from the mother crab and settled somewhere else

layers.meaning: offspring of the cancer crab that left it and grew elsewhere, as metastases leave the primary
layers.place: they sit far from the mother crab (the primary), on another sack, island or organ

symbols.why: the cancer's children, travelled away from it
symbols.notes: Same family as lung cancer (the crab) on purpose.

symbols.symbol: a cat slicing a long loaf of bread into very thin slices with one sharp claw

layers.sound: a CAT scan, as everyone calls it
layers.meaning: the scanner cuts the body into thin cross-sections, as the cat slices the loaf

symbols.why: CAT scan = a cat; tomography = slices
symbols.notes: Say 'thin slices of a loaf' so the cat is not just a pet.

symbols.symbol: a glowing puppy (a pet) sniffing out the spots that eat sugar cubes and making them glow

layers.meaning: FDG is sugar: tissues that eat sugar fast (cancer, infection) light up where the puppy sniffs

symbols.why: PET = pet; it finds sugar-hungry tissue
symbols.notes: Combined PET-CT = the cat and the puppy together.

symbols.symbol: numbered railway stations along a sea-train line that runs down beside the ribbed hose (the trachea) and forks under it

layers.sound: a lymph node STATION is a railway station
layers.place: each numbered station stands where its nodes lie: high ones near the top of the hose, 7 under the fork (the carina), 10 at the branches

symbols.why: the nodes are literally called stations; a line of stations keeps their order
symbols.notes: Paint only the one or two station numbers the question needs (words:).

symbols.concept: trachea, windpipe (and the carina where it forks)
symbols.symbol: a big ribbed hose of stacked white C-shaped rings that forks into two hoses at its lower end

layers.meaning: the windpipe itself: a ringed tube that carries all the air
layers.place: it runs down from the neck and forks into two at the bottom (the carina and the main bronchi)

symbols.why: the trachea is a ringed hose; its fork is the carina

symbols.symbol: a brass tuba riddled with holes, soft white cheese oozing from them

layers.meaning: the holes are cavities, the cheese is caseating necrosis

symbols.why: tuba = TUBerculosis; holes and cheese = cavities and caseation
symbols.notes: Miliary TB = the tuba spraying a fine millet of tiny seeds everywhere.

symbols.symbol: a long pink sofa stretched into a slide, down which food slides from the mouth to a cooking pot

layers.meaning: food slides down it into the stomach
layers.place: it runs down behind the ribbed hose (the trachea), through the deck (the diaphragm), into the cooking pot (the stomach)

symbols.why: e-SOFA-gus; food slides down it
symbols.notes: Say 'a long pink sofa stretched into a slide' so it reads as a chute, not a seat.

symbols.symbol: a big copper cooking pot that receives the food at the bottom of the sofa slide

layers.meaning: the pot where the food is churned and cooked, as the stomach digests
layers.place: below the deck (the diaphragm), at the foot of the sofa slide; pulled up into the chest it is the gastric conduit

symbols.why: the stomach cooks the food; first used in lesson 10 (the pot through the torn deck)

symbols.symbol: a drawstring purse-neck tied round the bottom of the sofa slide where it enters the cooking pot

layers.meaning: a ring that squeezes shut and opens, as the sphincter does
layers.place: exactly where the sofa slide (oesophagus) enters the cooking pot (stomach)

symbols.why: a sphincter is a purse-string ring

symbols.symbol: bubbling green acid soup splashing back UP out of the cooking pot into the sofa slide, scorching it

layers.meaning: acid stomach contents flowing the wrong way and burning the lining
layers.place: from the pot (stomach) back up into the sofa slide (oesophagus)

symbols.why: reflux = flowing back; the burn of heartburn

symbols.symbol: the lowest stretch of the sofa slide relined with wooden barrel staves, like the inside of a barrel

layers.meaning: the lining changed into another kind (metaplasia), as cloth changed to staves
layers.place: at the bottom of the slide, just above the pot, where the acid soup splashes

symbols.why: Barrett = barrel; the lining replaced near the GE junction

symbols.symbol: a golden chalice jammed in the drawstring at the bottom of the sofa slide, food piling up above it and the slide bulging wide

layers.meaning: the outlet does not open, so food piles up and the oesophagus dilates
layers.place: stuck in the lower sphincter (the drawstring)

symbols.why: achalasia = a chalice stuck in the outlet

symbols.symbol: the rim of the cooking pot folded up and wrapped round the bottom of the sofa slide like a scarf

layers.meaning: the fundus of the stomach wrapped round the oesophagus to stop reflux
layers.place: the pot's own rim (the fundus) round the foot of the slide

symbols.why: a wrap of the stomach round the oesophagus
symbols.notes: A partial wrap = the scarf only half way round.

symbols.symbol: a bushy pot of thyme growing at the very front of the chest cabin

layers.place: the thymus lies in the anterior mediastinum: the front of the cabin

symbols.why: thymus = thyme, and it sits in front
symbols.notes: A thymoma = the thyme bush grown huge.

symbols.symbol: a yellow excavator digging a deep hollow in the front of a treasure chest

layers.meaning: the front of the chest is dug in, hollow

symbols.why: excavatum = dug out
